text:
Theo: ok team, current status: built a 'bookshelf igloo' to hide my mic from upstairs hammer-apocalypse. it's... surprisingly cozy. any tips to keep heat down inside the igloo? also my upload dipped during the meeting. :sweat_smile:
Rina: love the term 'bookshelf igloo'  solid visual. heat: leave a small vent at the top, and put laptop on a metal cooling rack so airflow isn't fully blocked.
Mateo: toss a small USB fan on low inside the vent. also, move mic onto a folded hoodie or thick notepad so desk thumps don't transfer.
Theo: doing the hoodie trick. speedtest from mid-demo: ```
Ping: 27 ms
Download: 9.4 Mbps
Upload: 0.8 Mbps
```
Kara: upload <1 is rough for camera + screen share. if you can, run an Ethernet cable out the window and down to the router (ghetto, but it works) or hotspot your phone as fallback.
Rina: also check background apps. some cloud backup apps like to sync video files right during calls.
NetBot: Provider alert: maintenance window earlier today in your area (Ref: MAINT-2026-017). Estimated restore: 1977785000. Check your ISP status page for details.
Mateo: if you go ethernet-out-the-window, tape the cable with weatherproof tape so the window seal doesn't squish the cable. Bonus: dramatic 'I sacrificed a cable for the team' photo for Slack.
Theo: heroically sacrificing a Cat6, will post picture if I survive the commute to the living room. :laughing:
Kara: obligatory: if the igloo fails, embrace it and declare "new office aesthetic." bonus points for matching sweater.
Theo: noted. deploying fan+vent now. will report back with victory or a very warm igloo. thanks y'all!
